name: xlsx
tagline_zh: Excel 又乱又卡？让它直接读改 xlsx、csv，公式、图表、清洗一气呵成。别处没有：连 .xlsm 宏文件都。
tagline_en: Excel messy? Let it read, edit, and fix xlsx, csv, even .xlsm macros. Formulas, charts, cleaning—done. Format.
desc_en: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger e
why_zh: 同类工具只敢碰干净表格，它连宏文件都敢处理，转换格式不丢数据，是真正的硬核救火员。
why_en: Others fear messy files; it handles .xlsm macros and converts formats without data loss. A true firefighter for spreadsheets.
